name: Old Nick
lore: A winter courier who knows every doorstep in Crossroads, even when the paths are buried in snow.
passive: Gift Wrap: every third damaging parcel hit strengthens your next Care Package.

technique.name: Doorstep Bell
technique.description: Swing your parcel sack in a close arc. A successful swing counts once toward Gift Wrap.

attack.name: Doorstep Bell
attack.description: Swing your parcel sack in a close arc. A successful swing counts once toward Gift Wrap.
attack.ui_brief: Swing your parcel sack in a close arc. A successful swing counts once toward Gift Wrap.

final_technique.name: Emergency Delivery
final_technique.description: Parachute a supply crate to the aimed area. On landing, heal allies for 24 and grant 30% damage reduction for 2 seconds.

attack.name: Emergency Delivery
attack.description: Parachute a supply crate to the aimed area. On landing, heal allies for 24 and grant 30% damage reduction for 2 seconds.
attack.ui_brief: Parachute a supply crate to the aimed area. On landing, heal allies for 24 and grant 30% damage reduction for 2 seconds.

primary.name: Special Delivery
primary.description: Toss a parcel that bursts on the first enemy.
primary.ui_brief: Toss a parcel that bursts on the first enemy.

secondary.name: Care Package
secondary.description: Aim and lob a wrapped parcel that heals and shields the ally who collects it.
secondary.ui_brief: Aim and lob a wrapped parcel that heals and shields the ally who collects it.

special.name: Midnight Delivery
special.description: Three parachute parcels descend to marked landing spots. They burst on impact, damaging nearby enemies and opening into healing gifts.
